mapper.select: SELECT '' AS SOURCE_DATE, a.`LEDGER_ID`, a.`QUESTION_ID`, a.QUESTION_CONTENT FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger` a WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} GROUP BY a.QUESTION_CONTENT ORDER BY a.`ADD_DATE`
SELECT t1.RULE_FILE_NAME, t1.RULE_FILE_NO, t1.RULE_FILE_CONTENT, t1.`SORT` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_ledger_rule` t1 WHERE t1.`LEDGER_ID` = #{params.LEDGER_ID} ORDER BY t1.`SORT`
SELECT a.INSPECTION_TASK_TYPE FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task` a WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID}

SELECT a.LEDGER_ID, a.`QUESTION_ID_1`, a.QUESTION_DSCR_1, a.`QUESTION_ID_2`, a.QUESTION_DSCR_2, a.`QUESTION_ID`, a.QUESTION_DSCR, a.ADD_USERID, e.`REALNAME` AS NAME, a.QUESTION_OPINIONS_ID, a.QUESTION_OPINIONS, a.PATH AS path, a.QUESTION_CONTENT, a.ERROR_TYPE, GROUP_CONCAT(d.RULE_DSCR SEPARATOR '\n') AS concent, a.`IS_LIST`, CASE WHEN a.`IS_LIST` = '0' THEN '是' WHEN a.`IS_LIST` = '1' THEN '否' END AS IS_LIST_DSCR, a.`IS_REPORT`, CASE WHEN a.`IS_REPORT` = '0' THEN '是' WHEN a.`IS_REPORT` = '1' THEN '否' END AS IS_REPORT_DSCR, CONCAT(a.QUESTION_CONTENT,a.`IS_LIST`,a.`IS_REPORT`,a.QUESTION_OPINIONS, a.ADD_USERID) AS IS_MERGE FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger` a JOIN `jeecg-boot-os`.`sys_user` e ON a.`ADD_USERID` = e.ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.`LEDGER_ID`, CONCAT('《',r.`RULE_FILE_NAME`,'》（',r.`RULE_FILE_NO`, '）',r.`RULE_FILE_CONTENT`) AS RULE_DSCR FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger_rule` r ) d ON a.`LEDGER_ID`= d.`LEDGER_ID`
WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.TASK_ID =#{params.TASK_ID}
AND a.ADD_USERID =#{params.ADD_USERID}
GROUP BY a.LEDGER_ID,a.QUESTION_CONTENT ORDER BY
a.`QUESTION_ID_1`, a.`QUESTION_ID_2`,
a.QUESTION_CONTENT, a.ADD_USERID, a.ADD_DATE DESC

SELECT a.`ADD_USERID` AS ADD_USERID, e.`REALNAME` AS NAME FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger` a JOIN `jeecg-boot-os`.`sys_user` e ON a.`ADD_USERID` = e.ID WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} GROUP BY a.`ADD_USERID`
